experiences.headline: Party Playlist Votes - Creator
experiences.details: · Built anative mobile app for Android and iOS that allows a party host to invite party attendees to vote on event music, which reduced decision times by 45 minutes on average · Started with amobile app for Android, and then learned Swift to port it to iOS · Utilized the Spotify API, and built an interactive, real-time voting function on top of it · Used Swift, Java, SQL, HTML/CSS in creation and maintenance, implementing user feedback

experiences.headline: University of Pittsburgh Soccer - Captain
experiences.details: · Communicated practices and events to team, working in partnership with coaches to streamline team information · Led initiative to mentor and coach local youth soccer teams in the community for 12 hours each summer month
